success=false deliberately means acceptance/runtime pending, not a failed JSON parse. Consumers requiring success=true must not treat this candidate as accepted.

axis is a USD joint-local unit vector, not world-space or Y-up bounds-space. Local rotations and raw attributes remain intact.
total_mass/total_object_mass_kg preserve original sum of known masses; do not assume completeness when any part mass is null.
Four corrected object_visual_bounds values follow the audit all-mesh selection (including collider/invisible geometry), not the historical visible-only name; per-part bounds are untouched.
